content:
A meaningful chapter of learning, research, and collaboration. 

Grateful to have successfully completed my internship at International Institute of SDG's and Public Policy Research in the Research domain. 

The key highlights of this experience was working with my fellow teammates on a research article titled “India’s Trade Policy and Economic Relations with the Global South in International Development.” This opportunity allowed me to explore international development and trade policy while strengthening my research, analytical, and teamwork skills.

Thankful to the institute, my mentors, and my teammates for making this a valuable learning experience.
Looking forward to learning, researching, and growing further.
